import factors = "./factors.qui"

class Step(int variable, int fill, int[] scope, int size)
class Plan(Step[] steps, int maximum, int total)

Plan make_plan(factors.Factor[] initial, int[] eliminate, bool minfill, int[] given, int[] sizes)
    count := int(#sizes)
    graph := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then [for j := (0:<int(count))[] then false]]
    active := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then false]
    for factor := initial[]
        for variable := factor.variables[]
            active[variable] = true
        for a := factor.variables[]
            for b := factor.variables[]
                if a != b
                    graph[a][b] = true
    remaining := eliminate
    Step[] steps := []
    maximum := 0
    total := 0
    while #remaining != 0
        variable := -1
        selected_fill := 0
        selected_degree := 0
        for candidate := (if minfill then remaining else given)[]
            if not factors.includes(remaining, candidate)
                continue
            neighbours := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] if active[i] and graph[candidate][i] then i]
            fill := 0
            for: a < int(#neighbours)
                for: a + 1 <= b < int(#neighbours)
                    if not graph[neighbours[a]][neighbours[b]]
                        fill += 1
            degree := int(#neighbours)
            if variable < 0 or (minfill and (fill < selected_fill or (fill == selected_fill and degree < selected_degree) or (fill == selected_fill and degree == selected_degree and candidate < variable)))
                variable = candidate
                selected_fill = fill
                selected_degree = degree
            if not minfill
                break
        neighbours := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] if active[i] and graph[variable][i] then i]
        scope := neighbours.append(variable).sorted()
        size := factors.entry_count(scope, sizes)
        steps = steps.append(Step(variable, selected_fill, scope, size))
        if size > maximum
            maximum = size
        total += size
        for a := neighbours[]
            for b := neighbours[]
                if a != b
                    graph[a][b] = true
        for neighbour := neighbours[]
            graph[neighbour][variable] = false
            graph[variable][neighbour] = false
        active[variable] = false
        remaining = [for item := remaining[] if item != variable then item]
    return Plan(steps, maximum, total)

class Executed(factors.Factor final_factor, factors.Factor[] products, int[] variables)

Executed execute(factors.Factor[] initial, Plan plan, int[] sizes, bool maximize)
    working := initial
    factors.Factor[] products := []
    int[] variables := []
    for step := plan.steps[]
        selected := [for factor := working[] if factors.includes(factor.variables, step.variable) then factor]
        working = [for factor := working[] if not factors.includes(factor.variables, step.variable) then factor]
        product := factors.multiply(selected, sizes)
        working = working.append(product.eliminate(step.variable, maximize))
        if maximize
            products = products.append(product)
            variables = variables.append(step.variable)
    return Executed(factors.multiply(working, sizes), products, variables)

int[] traceback(Executed result, int[] sizes)
    assignment := [for i := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then -1]
    index := int(#result.variables) - 1
    while index >= 0
        variable := result.variables[index]
        product := result.products[index]
        best := 0
        assignment[variable] = 0
        maximum := product.value(assignment)
        for: 1 <= state < sizes[variable]
            assignment[variable] = state
            value := product.value(assignment)
            if value > maximum
                maximum = value
                best = state
        assignment[variable] = best
        index -= 1
    return assignment

import learning = "./learning.qui"

bool includes(int[] variables, int wanted)
    for variable := variables[]
        if variable == wanted
            return true
    return false

int entry_count(int[] variables, int[] sizes)
    result := 1
    for variable := variables[]
        result *= sizes[variable]
    return result

int[][] assignments(int[] variables, int[] sizes)
    count := entry_count(variables, sizes)
    int[][] result := []
    for: index < count
        assignment := [for i := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then -1]
        remaining := index
        position := int(#variables) - 1
        while position >= 0
            variable := variables[position]
            assignment[variable] = remaining % sizes[variable]
            remaining /= sizes[variable]
            position -= 1
        result = result.append(assignment)
    return result

class Factor(int[] variables, real64[] values, int[] sizes)
    real64 value(int[] assignment)
        index := 0
        for variable := variables[]
            index = index * sizes[variable] + assignment[variable]
        return values[index]

    Factor reduced(int[] evidence)
        retained := [for variable := variables[] if evidence[variable] < 0 then variable]
        real64[] result := []
        for assignment := assignments(retained, sizes)[]
            for: variable < int(#sizes)
                if evidence[variable] >= 0
                    assignment[variable] = evidence[variable]
            result = result.append(value(assignment))
        return Factor(retained, result, sizes)

    Factor multiplied(Factor other)
        joined := [for variable := (0:<int(#sizes))[] if includes(variables, variable) or includes(other.variables, variable) then variable]
        real64[] result := []
        for assignment := assignments(joined, sizes)[]
            result = result.append(value(assignment) * other.value(assignment))
        return Factor(joined, result, sizes)

    Factor eliminate(int variable, bool maximize)
        retained := [for item := variables[] if item != variable then item]
        real64[] result := []
        for assignment := assignments(retained, sizes)[]
            real64[] candidates := []
            for: state < sizes[variable]
                assignment[variable] = state
                candidates = candidates.append(value(assignment))
            reduced_value := candidates[0]
            for: 1 <= state < sizes[variable]
                if maximize
                    if candidates[state] > reduced_value
                        reduced_value = candidates[state]
                else
                    reduced_value += candidates[state]
            result = result.append(reduced_value)
        return Factor(retained, result, sizes)

Factor cpt_factor(int variable, int[] parents, real64[][] cpt, int[] sizes)
    variables := parents.append(variable).sorted()
    values := [for assignment := assignments(variables, sizes)[] then cpt[learning.parent_row(parents, assignment, sizes)][assignment[variable]]]
    return Factor(variables, values, sizes)

Factor multiply(Factor[] values, int[] sizes)
    if #values == 0
        return Factor([], [1.0], sizes)
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result = result.multiplied(values[i])
    return result

import math

real64 ordered_sum(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result += values[i]
    return result

int parent_row(int[] parents, int[] assignment, int[] sizes)
    row := 0
    for parent := parents[]
        row = row * sizes[parent] + assignment[parent]
    return row

int[][] count_samples(int variable, int[] parents, int[][] samples, int[] sizes)
    rows := 1
    for parent := parents[]
        rows *= sizes[parent]
    counts := [for row := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for state := (0:<int(sizes[variable]))[] then 0]]
    for sample := samples[]
        counts[parent_row(parents, sample, sizes)][sample[variable]] += 1
    return counts

real64[][] learn(int[][] counts, real64 alpha)
    real64[][] result := []
    for row := counts[]
        denominator := ordered_sum([for count := row[] then real64(count) + alpha])
        result = result.append([for count := row[] then (real64(count) + alpha) / denominator])
    return result

real64 log_likelihood(int[][] counts, real64[][] cpt)
    real64[] terms := []
    for: row < int(#counts)
        for: state < int(#counts[row])
            if counts[row][state] != 0
                logarithm := math.log(cpt[row][state])
                terms = terms.append(real64(counts[row][state]) * logarithm)
    return ordered_sum(terms)

int parameter_count(int[][] counts)
    return (int(#counts[0]) - 1) * int(#counts)

real64 family_score(int variable, int[] parents, int[][] samples, int[] sizes, real64 alpha)
    counts := count_samples(variable, parents.sorted(), samples, sizes)
    cpt := learn(counts, alpha)
    logarithm := math.log(real64(#samples))
    return log_likelihood(counts, cpt) - real64(parameter_count(counts)) * logarithm / 2.0

import math
import network_io = "./network_io.qui"
import learning = "./learning.qui"
import factors = "./factors.qui"
import elimination = "./elimination.qui"
import sampling = "./sampling.qui"

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

string format_real(real64 value)
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    units := math.floor(magnitude * 10000.0 + 0.5)
    tail := string(units % 10000)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and units != 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign + string(units / 10000) + "." + "0" * nat(4 - int(#tail)) + tail

string real_values(real64[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then format_real(value)].join(" ")

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

int[] canonical(int[] variables)
    int[] result := []
    for variable := variables.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != variable
            result = result.append(variable)
    return result

int[] closure(int[] seeds, int[][] adjacent)
    size := int(#adjacent)
    visited := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then false]
    queue := canonical(seeds)
    for variable := queue[]
        visited[variable] = true
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        variable := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for other := adjacent[variable][]
            if not visited[other]
                visited[other] = true
                queue = queue.append(other)
    return [for variable := (0:<int(size))[] if visited[variable] then variable]

int[] topological_order(int[][] parents)
    size := int(#parents)
    chosen := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then false]
    int[] result := []
    while int(#result) < size
        for: variable < size
            if chosen[variable]
                continue
            ready := true
            for parent := parents[variable][]
                ready = ready and chosen[parent]
            if ready
                chosen[variable] = true
                result = result.append(variable)
                break
    return result

int[][] children_of(int[][] parents)
    size := int(#parents)
    int[][] result := [for variable := (0:<int(size))[] then []]
    for: variable < size
        for parent := parents[variable][]
            result[parent] = result[parent].append(variable)
    return result

int[] spouses_of(int variable, int[][] parents, int[][] children)
    int[] spouses := []
    for child := children[variable][]
        for parent := parents[child][]
            if parent != variable and not factors.includes(parents[variable], parent) and not factors.includes(children[variable], parent)
                spouses = spouses.append(parent)
    return canonical(spouses)

int[] blanket_of(int variable, int[][] parents, int[][] children)
    return canonical(parents[variable].concat(children[variable]).concat(spouses_of(variable, parents, children)))

int assignment_index(int[] variables, int[] assignment, int[] sizes)
    index := 0
    for variable := variables[]
        index = index * sizes[variable] + assignment[variable]
    return index

int[] decode_assignment(int[] variables, int[] sizes, int index)
    assignment := [for i := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then -1]
    remaining := index
    position := int(#variables) - 1
    while position >= 0
        variable := variables[position]
        assignment[variable] = remaining % sizes[variable]
        remaining /= sizes[variable]
        position -= 1
    return assignment

int[] observed_variables(int[] evidence)
    return [for v := (0:<int(#evidence))[] if evidence[v] >= 0 then v]

real64 logarithm(real64 value)
    result := math.log(value)
    return result

factors.Factor normalized(factors.Factor factor)
    sum := learning.ordered_sum(factor.values)
    return factors.Factor(factor.variables, [for value := factor.values[] then value / sum], factor.sizes)

real64[][] marginal_values(factors.Factor distribution, int[] variables, int[] sizes)
    real64[][] result := [for v := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then [for state := (0:<int(sizes[v]))[] then 0.0]]
    assignments := factors.assignments(distribution.variables, sizes)
    for: i < int(#assignments)
        for variable := variables[]
            result[variable][assignments[i][variable]] += distribution.values[i]
    return result

bool distributions_agree(factors.Factor first, factors.Factor second)
    if first.variables != second.variables or #first.values != #second.values
        return false
    for: i < int(#first.values)
        if absolute(first.values[i] - second.values[i]) > 0.000000001
            return false
    return true

class Posterior(int[] relevant, int[] eliminate, factors.Factor[] initial, elimination.Plan minfill, elimination.Plan given, factors.Factor distribution, real64 evidence_probability)

class Engine(network_io.Network network, int[] sizes, real64[][][] cpts, factors.Factor[] cpt_factors, network_io.Params params)
    Posterior posterior(int[] query_variables, int[] evidence)
        relevant := closure(query_variables.concat(observed_variables(evidence)), network.parents)
        initial := [for variable := relevant[] then cpt_factors[variable].reduced(evidence)]
        eliminate := [for variable := relevant[] if evidence[variable] < 0 and not factors.includes(query_variables, variable) then variable]
        minfill := elimination.make_plan(initial, eliminate, true, params.order, sizes)
        given := elimination.make_plan(initial, eliminate, false, params.order, sizes)
        used := if params.minfill then minfill else given
        final_factor := elimination.execute(initial, used, sizes, false).final_factor
        evidence_probability := learning.ordered_sum(final_factor.values)
        return Posterior(relevant, eliminate, initial, minfill, given, normalized(final_factor), evidence_probability)

    real64 joint(int[] assignment, int[] variables)
        if #variables == 0
            return 1.0
        first := variables[0]
        result := cpts[first][learning.parent_row(network.parents[first], assignment, sizes)][assignment[first]]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#variables)
            variable := variables[i]
            result *= cpts[variable][learning.parent_row(network.parents[variable], assignment, sizes)][assignment[variable]]
        return result

    string enumeration_check(Posterior posterior_result, int[] query_variables, int[] evidence)
        unobserved := [for variable := posterior_result.relevant[] if evidence[variable] < 0 then variable]
        count := factors.entry_count(unobserved, sizes)
        if count > params.enumeration_limit
            return "skipped"
        scope := canonical(query_variables)
        real64[] values := [for i := (0:<int(factors.entry_count(scope, sizes)))[] then 0.0]
        for assignment := factors.assignments(unobserved, sizes)[]
            for variable := observed_variables(evidence)[]
                assignment[variable] = evidence[variable]
            values[assignment_index(scope, assignment, sizes)] += joint(assignment, posterior_result.relevant)
        probability := learning.ordered_sum(values)
        distribution := normalized(factors.Factor(scope, values, sizes))
        agree := distributions_agree(distribution, posterior_result.distribution) and absolute(logarithm(probability) - logarithm(posterior_result.evidence_probability)) <= 0.000000001
        return if agree then "agree" else "disagree"

class Query(string kind, int[] variables, int[] evidence, int[] evidence_order, int[] counts, int[][] sets, string operation, int first, int second)

Query parse_query(string line, network_io.Network network)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    kind := fields[0]
    size := int(#network.names)
    int[] variables := []
    evidence := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then -1]
    int[] evidence_order := []
    int[] counts := []
    int[][] sets := []
    operation := ""
    first := -1
    second := -1
    if kind == "DSEP"
        sets = [[]]
        for field := fields[1:<int(#fields)][]
            if field == "|"
                sets = sets.append([])
            else
                index := int(#sets) - 1
                sets[index] = sets[index].append(network_io.name_index(network.names, field))
        if #sets == 2
            sets = sets.append([])
        sets = [for group := sets[] then canonical(group)]
    elif kind == "EDGE"
        operation = fields[1]
        first = network_io.name_index(network.names, fields[2])
        second = network_io.name_index(network.names, fields[3])
    elif kind == "PREDICT" or kind == "BLANKET"
        variables = [network_io.name_index(network.names, fields[1])]
    else
        observing := kind == "MPE"
        counting := false
        for field := fields[1:<int(#fields)][]
            if field == "COUNTS"
                counting = true
            elif counting
                counts = counts.append(network_io.integer(field))
            elif field == "|"
                observing = true
            elif observing
                pair := field.split("=")
                variable := network_io.name_index(network.names, pair[0])
                evidence[variable] = network_io.name_index(network.states[variable], pair[1])
                evidence_order = evidence_order.append(variable)
            else
                variables = variables.append(network_io.name_index(network.names, field))
    return Query(kind, variables, evidence, evidence_order, counts, sets, operation, first, second)

class Separation(bool separated, int[] reachable)

Separation bayes_ball(int[] xs, int[] ys, int[] zs, int[][] parents, int[][] children)
    size := int(#parents)
    ancestors := closure(zs, parents)
    visited := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then [false, false]]
    queue := [for x := xs[] then [x, 0]]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        variable := queue[cursor][0]
        direction := queue[cursor][1]
        cursor += 1
        if visited[variable][direction]
            continue
        visited[variable][direction] = true
        observed := factors.includes(zs, variable)
        if direction == 0 and not observed
            for parent := parents[variable][]
                queue = queue.append([parent, 0])
            for child := children[variable][]
                queue = queue.append([child, 1])
        elif direction == 1
            if not observed
                for child := children[variable][]
                    queue = queue.append([child, 1])
            if factors.includes(ancestors, variable)
                for parent := parents[variable][]
                    queue = queue.append([parent, 0])
    reachable := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if (visited[v][0] or visited[v][1]) and not factors.includes(zs, v) and not factors.includes(xs, v) then v]
    separated := true
    for y := ys[]
        if factors.includes(reachable, y)
            separated = false
    return Separation(separated, reachable)

int map_count(map<int, int> values, int key)
    match values.get(key)
        int count
            return count
        none
            return 0

class Information(real64 cmi, real64 g2, int df)

Information conditional_information(int[][] sets, int[][] samples, int[] sizes)
    xs := sets[0]
    ys := sets[1]
    zs := sets[2]
    scope := canonical(xs.concat(ys).concat(zs))
    xz := canonical(xs.concat(zs))
    yz := canonical(ys.concat(zs))
    map<int, int> counts
    map<int, int> counts_xz
    map<int, int> counts_yz
    map<int, int> counts_z
    for sample := samples[]
        key := assignment_index(scope, sample, sizes)
        .counts.set(key, map_count(counts, key) + 1)
        key = assignment_index(xz, sample, sizes)
        .counts_xz.set(key, map_count(counts_xz, key) + 1)
        key = assignment_index(yz, sample, sizes)
        .counts_yz.set(key, map_count(counts_yz, key) + 1)
        key = assignment_index(zs, sample, sizes)
        .counts_z.set(key, map_count(counts_z, key) + 1)
    real64[] terms := []
    n := int(#samples)
    for key := counts.keys().sorted()[]
        assignment := decode_assignment(scope, sizes, key)
        count := map_count(counts, key)
        nz := map_count(counts_z, assignment_index(zs, assignment, sizes))
        nxz := map_count(counts_xz, assignment_index(xz, assignment, sizes))
        nyz := map_count(counts_yz, assignment_index(yz, assignment, sizes))
        terms = terms.append((real64(count) / real64(n)) * logarithm(real64(count * nz) / real64(nxz * nyz)))
    cmi := learning.ordered_sum(terms)
    df := (factors.entry_count(xs, sizes) - 1) * (factors.entry_count(ys, sizes) - 1) * factors.entry_count(zs, sizes)
    return Information(cmi, 2.0 * real64(n) * cmi, df)

int[] path_search(int[][] children, int first, int last, int ignored_first, int ignored_last)
    size := int(#children)
    predecessors := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then -1]
    predecessors[first] = first
    queue := [first]
    cursor := 0
    found := false
    while cursor < int(#queue) and not found
        variable := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for child := children[variable][]
            if (variable == ignored_first and child == ignored_last) or predecessors[child] >= 0
                continue
            predecessors[child] = variable
            if child == last
                found = true
                break
            queue = queue.append(child)
    if not found
        return []
    path := [last]
    current := last
    while current != first
        current = predecessors[current]
        path = path.append(current)
    return path[::-1]

class Study(network_io.Input data)
    network_io.Network network := data.network
    network_io.Params params := data.params
    size := int(#network.names)
    sample_count := int(#data.samples)
    int[] sizes := [for states := network.states[] then int(#states)]
    int[] variables := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then v]
    int[] no_evidence := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then -1]
    int[][] children := children_of(network.parents)
    int[] topological := topological_order(network.parents)
    int[] depths := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    for v := topological[]
        for parent := network.parents[v][]
            if depths[parent] + 1 > depths[v]
                depths[v] = depths[parent] + 1
    int[][] ancestors := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then closure(network.parents[v], network.parents)]
    int[][] descendants := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then closure(children[v], children)]
    int[][] blankets := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then blanket_of(v, network.parents, children)]
    int[][][] counts := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then learning.count_samples(v, network.parents[v], data.samples, sizes)]
    real64[][][] learned := [for table := counts[] then learning.learn(table, params.alpha)]
    real64[][][] cpts := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then (if params.learned[v] then learned[v] else network.expert[v])]
    real64[] loglik := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then learning.log_likelihood(counts[v], cpts[v])]
    int[] parameters := [for table := counts[] then learning.parameter_count(table)]
    log_samples := logarithm(real64(sample_count))
    real64[] bic := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then loglik[v] - real64(parameters[v]) * log_samples / 2.0]
    factors.Factor[] cpt_factors := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then factors.cpt_factor(v, network.parents[v], cpts[v], sizes)]
    engine := Engine(network, sizes, cpts, cpt_factors, params)
    generator := sampling.Generator(params.seed)
    string[][] answers := []
    string[][] elimination_blocks := []
    string[][] structure_blocks := []
    sampling_rows := ["query,samples,variable,state,estimate,exact,abs_error"]

    string variable_names(int[] items)
        return if #items == 0 then "-" else [for variable := items[] then network.names[variable]].join(" ")

    string assignment_text(int[] items, int[] assignment)
        return if #items == 0 then "-" else [for variable := items[] then network.names[variable] + "=" + network.states[variable][assignment[variable]]].join(" ")

    string marginal_text(string prefix, int variable, real64[] values)
        parts := [for state := (0:<int(sizes[variable]))[] then network.states[variable][state] + " " + format_real(values[state])]
        return prefix + " " + network.names[variable] + " " + parts.join(" ")

    string[] plan_lines(elimination.Plan plan)
        string[] lines := []
        for step := plan.steps[]
            lines = lines.append("step {network.names[step.variable]} fill {step.fill} scope " + variable_names(step.scope) + " entries {step.size}")
        return lines.append("cost max {plan.maximum} total {plan.total}")

    void .store_elimination(int number, string line, int[] relevant, int[] eliminate, elimination.Plan minfill, elimination.Plan given, bool agree, int enumeration_count, string enumeration_verdict)
        pruned := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if not factors.includes(relevant, v) then v]
        used := if params.minfill then "minfill" else "given"
        string[] lines := ["query {number} {line}", "relevant " + variable_names(relevant), "pruned " + variable_names(pruned), "eliminate " + variable_names(eliminate), "order minfill"]
        lines = lines.concat(plan_lines(minfill)).append("order given").concat(plan_lines(given))
        elimination_blocks = elimination_blocks.append(lines.concat(["used {used}", "orders_agree " + yes_no(agree), "enumeration {enumeration_count} {enumeration_verdict}"]))

    void .handle_query(int number, string line, Query query)
        Posterior result := engine.posterior(query.variables, query.evidence)
        marginals := marginal_values(result.distribution, query.variables, sizes)
        log_evidence := logarithm(result.evidence_probability)
        lines := ["query {number} {line}", "log_evidence " + format_real(log_evidence)]
        if #query.evidence_order != 0
            real64[] terms := []
            for variable := query.evidence_order[]
                single := no_evidence
                single[variable] = query.evidence[variable]
                terms = terms.append(logarithm(engine.posterior([], single).evidence_probability))
            lines = lines.append("conflict " + format_real(learning.ordered_sum(terms) - log_evidence))
        if #query.variables >= 2
            assignments := factors.assignments(result.distribution.variables, sizes)
            for: i < int(#assignments)
                lines = lines.append("joint " + assignment_text(result.distribution.variables, assignments[i]) + " " + format_real(result.distribution.values[i]))
        for variable := query.variables[]
            lines = lines.append(marginal_text("marginal", variable, marginals[variable]))
        for variable := query.evidence_order[]
            evidence := query.evidence
            evidence[variable] = -1
            Posterior dropped := engine.posterior(query.variables, evidence)
            other := marginal_values(dropped.distribution, query.variables, sizes)
            real64 shift := 0.0
            for q := query.variables[]
                for: state < sizes[q]
                    difference := absolute(marginals[q][state] - other[q][state])
                    if difference > shift
                        shift = difference
            lines = lines.append("drop {network.names[variable]}={network.states[variable][query.evidence[variable]]} shift " + format_real(shift))
        answers = answers.append(lines)
        first := elimination.execute(result.initial, result.minfill, sizes, false).final_factor
        second := elimination.execute(result.initial, result.given, sizes, false).final_factor
        agree := distributions_agree(normalized(first), normalized(second)) and absolute(logarithm(learning.ordered_sum(first.values)) - logarithm(learning.ordered_sum(second.values))) <= 0.000000001
        unobserved := [for v := result.relevant[] if query.evidence[v] < 0 then v]
        .store_elimination(number, line, result.relevant, result.eliminate, result.minfill, result.given, agree, factors.entry_count(unobserved, sizes), engine.enumeration_check(result, query.variables, query.evidence))

    void .handle_mpe(int number, string line, Query query)
        unobserved := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if query.evidence[v] < 0 then v]
        initial := [for factor := cpt_factors[] then factor.reduced(query.evidence)]
        minfill := elimination.make_plan(initial, unobserved, true, params.order, sizes)
        given := elimination.make_plan(initial, unobserved, false, params.order, sizes)
        first := elimination.execute(initial, minfill, sizes, true)
        second := elimination.execute(initial, given, sizes, true)
        first_assignment := elimination.traceback(first, sizes)
        second_assignment := elimination.traceback(second, sizes)
        for v := observed_variables(query.evidence)[]
            first_assignment[v] = query.evidence[v]
            second_assignment[v] = query.evidence[v]
        selected := if params.minfill then first else second
        assignment := if params.minfill then first_assignment else second_assignment
        joint_probability := selected.final_factor.values[0]
        log_joint := logarithm(joint_probability)
        real64 evidence_probability := if #query.evidence_order == 0 then 1.0 else engine.posterior([], query.evidence).evidence_probability
        string[] lines := ["query {number} {line}", "assignment " + assignment_text(variables, assignment), "log_joint " + format_real(log_joint), "log_evidence " + format_real(logarithm(evidence_probability)), "posterior " + format_real(joint_probability / evidence_probability)]
        for variable := unobserved[]
            eliminate := [for v := unobserved[] if v != variable then v]
            plan := elimination.make_plan(initial, eliminate, params.minfill, params.order, sizes)
            margin_factor := elimination.execute(initial, plan, sizes, true).final_factor
            best := -1
            for: state < sizes[variable]
                if state == assignment[variable]
                    continue
                if best < 0 or margin_factor.values[state] > margin_factor.values[best]
                    best = state
            margin := log_joint - logarithm(margin_factor.values[best])
            lines = lines.append("margin {network.names[variable]} {network.states[variable][best]} " + format_real(margin))
        answers = answers.append(lines)
        agree := first_assignment == second_assignment and absolute(logarithm(first.final_factor.values[0]) - logarithm(second.final_factor.values[0])) <= 0.000000001
        enumeration_count := factors.entry_count(unobserved, sizes)
        verdict := "skipped"
        if enumeration_count <= params.enumeration_limit
            real64 best_probability := -1.0
            int[] best_assignment := []
            for candidate := factors.assignments(unobserved, sizes)[]
                for v := observed_variables(query.evidence)[]
                    candidate[v] = query.evidence[v]
                real64 probability := engine.joint(candidate, variables)
                if probability > best_probability
                    best_probability = probability
                    best_assignment = candidate
            enumeration_agrees := assignment == best_assignment and absolute(logarithm(best_probability) - log_joint) <= 0.000000001
            verdict = if enumeration_agrees then "agree" else "disagree"
        .store_elimination(number, line, variables, unobserved, minfill, given, agree, enumeration_count, verdict)

    void .handle_sample(int number, string line, Query query)
        Posterior result := engine.posterior(query.variables, query.evidence)
        exact := marginal_values(result.distribution, query.variables, sizes)
        lines := ["query {number} {line}"]
        for variable := query.variables[]
            lines = lines.append(marginal_text("exact", variable, exact[variable]))
        real64 weight := 0.0
        real64 squared_weight := 0.0
        real64[][] totals := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then [for state := (0:<int(sizes[v]))[] then 0.0]]
        maximum_samples := query.counts[-1]
        for: 1 <= count <= maximum_samples
            sample := sampling.weighted_sample(topological, network.parents, cpts, sizes, query.evidence, &generator)
            weight += sample.weight
            squared_weight += sample.weight * sample.weight
            for variable := query.variables[]
                totals[variable][sample.states[variable]] += sample.weight
            if not factors.includes(query.counts, count)
                continue
            real64 max_error := 0.0
            for variable := query.variables[]
                for: state < sizes[variable]
                    estimate := totals[variable][state] / weight
                    difference := absolute(estimate - exact[variable][state])
                    if difference > max_error
                        max_error = difference
                    sampling_rows = sampling_rows.append("{number},{count},{network.names[variable]},{network.states[variable][state]}," + format_real(estimate) + "," + format_real(exact[variable][state]) + "," + format_real(difference))
            ess := weight * weight / squared_weight
            lines = lines.append("after {count} weight " + format_real(weight) + " ess " + format_real(ess) + " max_error " + format_real(max_error))
        answers = answers.append(lines)

    void .handle_predict(int number, string line, int variable)
        states := sizes[variable]
        confusion := [for a := (0:<int(states))[] then [for b := (0:<int(states))[] then 0]]
        real64[] log_terms := []
        for original := data.samples[]
            actual := original[variable]
            real64[] values := []
            for: state < states
                assignment := original
                assignment[variable] = state
                value := cpts[variable][learning.parent_row(network.parents[variable], assignment, sizes)][state]
                for child := children[variable][]
                    value *= cpts[child][learning.parent_row(network.parents[child], assignment, sizes)][assignment[child]]
                values = values.append(value)
            denominator := learning.ordered_sum(values)
            probabilities := [for value := values[] then value / denominator]
            predicted := 0
            for: 1 <= state < states
                if probabilities[state] > probabilities[predicted]
                    predicted = state
            confusion[actual][predicted] += 1
            log_terms = log_terms.append(logarithm(probabilities[actual]))
        correct := 0
        for: state < states
            correct += confusion[state][state]
        loss := -learning.ordered_sum(log_terms) / real64(sample_count)
        string[] lines := ["query {number} {line}", "blanket " + variable_names(blankets[variable]), "accuracy {correct}/{sample_count} " + format_real(real64(correct) / real64(sample_count)), "log_loss " + format_real(loss), "predicted " + network.states[variable].join(" ")]
        for: state < states
            lines = lines.append("actual {network.states[variable][state]} " + [for count := confusion[state][] then string(count)].join(" "))
        answers = answers.append(lines)

    void .handle_structure(int number, string line, Query query)
        lines := ["query {number} {line}"]
        if query.kind == "DSEP"
            separation := bayes_ball(query.sets[0], query.sets[1], query.sets[2], network.parents, children)
            information := conditional_information(query.sets, data.samples, sizes)
            lines = lines.concat(["result " + (if separation.separated then "separated" else "connected"), "reachable " + variable_names(separation.reachable), "data cmi " + format_real(information.cmi) + " g2 " + format_real(information.g2) + " df {information.df}"])
        elif query.kind == "BLANKET"
            variable := query.variables[0]
            rest := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if v != variable and not factors.includes(blankets[variable], v) then v]
            separated := bayes_ball([variable], rest, blankets[variable], network.parents, children).separated
            lines = lines.concat(["parents " + variable_names(network.parents[variable]), "children " + variable_names(children[variable]), "spouses " + variable_names(spouses_of(variable, network.parents, children)), "blanket " + variable_names(blankets[variable]), "rest " + variable_names(rest), "rest_separated " + yes_no(separated)])
        else
            x := query.first
            y := query.second
            exists := factors.includes(network.parents[y], x)
            if query.operation == "ADD" and exists
                lines = lines.append("result exists")
            elif query.operation != "ADD" and not exists
                lines = lines.append("result missing")
            else
                int[] path := []
                if query.operation == "ADD"
                    path = path_search(children, y, x, -1, -1)
                elif query.operation == "REVERSE"
                    path = path_search(children, x, y, x, y)
                if #path != 0
                    int[] cycle := [if query.operation == "ADD" then x else y].concat(path)
                    lines = lines.append("result cycle " + [for v := cycle[] then network.names[v]].join(" -> "))
                else
                    after_parents := if query.operation == "ADD" then canonical(network.parents[y].append(x)) else [for parent := network.parents[y][] if parent != x then parent]
                    before_y := learning.family_score(y, network.parents[y], data.samples, sizes, params.alpha)
                    after_y := learning.family_score(y, after_parents, data.samples, sizes, params.alpha)
                    change := after_y - before_y
                    lines = lines.concat(["result ok", "family {network.names[y]} before " + format_real(before_y) + " after " + format_real(after_y)])
                    if query.operation == "REVERSE"
                        before_x := learning.family_score(x, network.parents[x], data.samples, sizes, params.alpha)
                        after_x := learning.family_score(x, canonical(network.parents[x].append(y)), data.samples, sizes, params.alpha)
                        change += after_x - before_x
                        lines = lines.append("family {network.names[x]} before " + format_real(before_x) + " after " + format_real(after_x))
                    lines = lines.append("delta " + format_real(change) + " " + (if change > 0.0 then "improves" else "worsens"))
        structure_blocks = structure_blocks.append(lines)

    void .process_queries()
        for: i < int(#data.queries)
            line := data.queries[i]
            query := parse_query(line, network)
            if query.kind == "QUERY"
                .handle_query(i + 1, line, query)
            elif query.kind == "MPE"
                .handle_mpe(i + 1, line, query)
            elif query.kind == "SAMPLE"
                .handle_sample(i + 1, line, query)
            elif query.kind == "PREDICT"
                .handle_predict(i + 1, line, query.variables[0])
            else
                .handle_structure(i + 1, line, query)

    string[] cpt_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        parameter_total := 0
        for: v < size
            source := if params.learned[v] then "LEARNED" else "GIVEN"
            string[] block := ["variable {network.names[v]} source {source}", "states " + network.states[v].join(" "), "parents " + variable_names(network.parents[v])]
            combinations := factors.assignments(network.parents[v], sizes)
            for: row < int(#counts[v])
                count_text := [for count := counts[v][row][] then string(count)].join(" ")
                block = block.append("row " + assignment_text(network.parents[v], combinations[row]) + " counts {count_text} probs " + real_values(cpts[v][row]))
            block = block.append("loglik " + format_real(loglik[v]) + " parameters {parameters[v]} bic " + format_real(bic[v]))
            Posterior marginal := engine.posterior([v], no_evidence)
            real64[] frequencies := []
            for: state < sizes[v]
                count := int(#[for sample := data.samples[] if sample[v] == state then sample])
                frequencies = frequencies.append(real64(count) / real64(sample_count))
            block = block.append("marginal model " + real_values(marginal.distribution.values) + " data " + real_values(frequencies))
            if params.learned[v]
                difference := "-"
                if #network.expert[v] != 0
                    real64 maximum_difference := 0.0
                    for: row < int(#learned[v])
                        for: state < sizes[v]
                            value := absolute(learned[v][row][state] - network.expert[v][row][state])
                            if value > maximum_difference
                                maximum_difference = value
                    difference = format_real(maximum_difference)
                block = block.append("given_difference " + difference)
            lines = lines.concat(block).append("")
            parameter_total += parameters[v]
        ll := learning.ordered_sum(loglik)
        network_bic := ll - real64(parameter_total) * log_samples / 2.0
        return lines.append("network samples {sample_count} pseudocount " + format_real(params.alpha) + " loglik " + format_real(ll) + " parameters {parameter_total} bic " + format_real(network_bic))

    int plan_width(elimination.Plan plan)
        largest := 0
        for step := plan.steps[]
            if int(#step.scope) > largest
                largest = int(#step.scope)
        return largest - 1

    string[] structure_lines()
        edge_count := 0
        moral := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] then [for u := (0:<int(size))[] then false]]
        for: v < size
            edge_count += int(#network.parents[v])
            family := network.parents[v].append(v)
            for a := family[]
                for b := family[]
                    if a != b
                        moral[a][b] = true
        moral_edges := 0
        for: a < size
            for: a + 1 <= b < size
                if moral[a][b]
                    moral_edges += 1
        minfill := elimination.make_plan(cpt_factors, variables, true, params.order, sizes)
        given := elimination.make_plan(cpt_factors, variables, false, params.order, sizes)
        roots := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if #network.parents[v] == 0 then v]
        leaves := [for v := (0:<int(size))[] if #children[v] == 0 then v]
        string[] lines := ["variables {size} edges {edge_count}", "topological_order " + variable_names(topological), "roots " + variable_names(roots), "leaves " + variable_names(leaves), "moral_edges {moral_edges} width minfill {plan_width(minfill)} given {plan_width(given)}"]
        for: v < size
            lines = lines.append("variable {network.names[v]} states {sizes[v]} parents {#network.parents[v]} children {#children[v]} depth {depths[v]} ancestors {#ancestors[v]} descendants {#descendants[v]} blanket {#blankets[v]}")
        for block := structure_blocks[]
            lines = lines.append("").concat(block)
        return lines

string[] joined_blocks(string[][] blocks)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := blocks[]
        if #lines != 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(block)
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + (if #lines == 0 then "" else NL))

void run_program()
    study := Study(network_io.read_inputs())
    .study.process_queries()
    write_lines("cpts.txt", study.cpt_lines())
    write_lines("structure.txt", study.structure_lines())
    write_lines("answers.txt", joined_blocks(study.answers))
    write_lines("elimination.txt", joined_blocks(study.elimination_blocks))
    write_lines("sampling.csv", study.sampling_rows)

run_program()

int integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

real64 number(string text)
    value := real64(text)
    return value

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

int name_index(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

class Network(string[] names, string[][] states, int[][] parents, real64[][][] expert)
class Params(real64 alpha, bool minfill, int[] order, int enumeration_limit, int seed, bool[] learned)
class Input(Network network, int[][] samples, string[] queries, Params params)

Network read_network()
    string[] lines := []
    for line := read_lines("input/network.txt")[]
        if line != "" and line[0] != "#"
            lines = lines.append(line)
    string[] names := []
    string[][] states := []
    int[][] parents := []
    real64[][][] expert := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[position].split(" ")
        position += 1
        if fields[0] == "VARIABLE"
            names = names.append(fields[1])
            states = states.append(fields[2:<int(#fields)])
            parents = parents.append([])
            expert = expert.append([])
        elif fields[0] == "PARENTS"
            parents[name_index(names, fields[1])] = [for name := fields[2:<int(#fields)][] then name_index(names, name)]
        else
            variable := name_index(names, fields[1])
            rows := 1
            for parent := parents[variable][]
                rows *= int(#states[parent])
            expert[variable] = [for i := (int(position):<int(position + rows))[] then [for value := lines[i].split(" ")[] then number(value)]]
            position += rows
    return Network(names, states, parents, expert)

Input read_inputs()
    network := read_network()
    settings := [for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")]
    params := Params(number(settings[0][1]), settings[1][1] == "MINFILL", [for name := settings[2][1:<int(#settings[2])][] then name_index(network.names, name)], integer(settings[3][1]), integer(settings[4][1]), [for i := (0:<int(#network.names))[] then settings[5 + i][2] == "LEARNED"])
    lines := read_lines("input/samples.csv")
    columns := [for name := lines[0].split(",")[] then name_index(network.names, name)]
    int[][] samples := []
    for line := lines[1:<int(#lines)][]
        fields := line.split(",")
        sample := [for i := (0:<int(#network.names))[] then 0]
        for: c < int(#columns)
            variable := columns[c]
            sample[variable] = name_index(network.states[variable], fields[c])
        samples = samples.append(sample)
    return Input(network, samples, read_lines("input/queries.txt"), params)

import learning = "./learning.qui"

class Generator(int state)
    real64 .uniform()
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        return real64(state) / 2147483647.0

int choose(real64[] probabilities, Generator &generator)
    uniform := .generator.uniform()
    real64 cumulative := 0.0
    for: state < int(#probabilities)
        cumulative += probabilities[state]
        if uniform < cumulative
            return state
    return int(#probabilities) - 1

class Sample(int[] states, real64 weight)

Sample weighted_sample(int[] order, int[][] parents, real64[][][] cpts, int[] sizes, int[] evidence, Generator &generator)
    states := [for v := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then 0]
    real64 weight := 1.0
    for variable := order[]
        probabilities := cpts[variable][learning.parent_row(parents[variable], states, sizes)]
        if evidence[variable] >= 0
            states[variable] = evidence[variable]
            weight *= probabilities[evidence[variable]]
        else
            states[variable] = choose(probabilities, &generator)
    return Sample(states, weight)
